title: Brute Force: Password Guessing (FTP)
mitre_source: Borisenko et al. (2022), DOI: 10.1109/SYNCHROINFO55067.2022.9840920, Table II
source_note: key_features: expected salience from ATT&CK documentation, not measured on this dataset. observed_features: top-5 mean |SHAP| over the training reference set of the named Layer 1 variant.
description: Adversaries may use brute force techniques to attempt access to valid accounts by guessing passwords. This profile focuses on FTP services where numerous login attempts are made systematically.

network_indicators.traffic_pattern: Frequent, rapid connection attempts to port 21, typically with small packet sizes representing repetitive USER and PASS commands.

mitigation.name: Account Use Policies
mitigation.action: Implement account lockout policies after a threshold of failed login attempts.

mitigation.name: Filter Network Traffic
mitigation.action: Limit the rate of connection attempts from a single source IP to the FTP service.

false_positive_hints: Misconfigured automated backup scripts or users with expired credentials can cause bursts of failed login attempts.
